description: This file defines classes and functions for representing and manipulating tensor sharding specifications in distributed training, including handling shard orders, tensor metadata, and device mesh placements.

classes.name: ShardOrderEntry
classes.description: Represents how a single tensor dimension is sharded across mesh dimensions, including tensor dimension index and mesh dimensions order.

classes.name: TensorMeta
classes.description: Simple named tuple to represent tensor metadata such as shape, stride, and dtype for sharding purposes.

classes.name: DTensorSpec
classes.description: Class encapsulating tensor sharding specifications, including device mesh, placements, tensor metadata, shard order, and related methods for normalization, conversion, validation, and representation.

methods.name: __post_init__
methods.description: Initializes DTensorSpec, normalizing placements and shard order.

methods.name: _normalize_placements_into_shard_order
methods.description: Normalizes placements into a shard order, converting _StridedShard to shard order if possible.

methods.name: compute_default_shard_order
methods.description: Computes default shard order based on placements, assuming left-to-right device order.

methods.name: _convert_shard_order_to_StridedShard
methods.description: Converts a shard order into placements with _StridedShard for non-default sharding.

methods.name: _maybe_convert_StridedShard_to_shard_order
methods.description: Attempts to convert _StridedShard placements back into a shard order, if possible.

methods.name: _verify_shard_order
methods.description: Verifies that a given shard order matches the current placements.

methods.name: __setattr__
methods.description: Overrides attribute setting to validate shard order and update hash cache.

methods.name: _hash_impl
methods.description: Computes a hash of the DTensorSpec for caching purposes.

methods.name: __hash__
methods.description: Returns cached hash value, computing if necessary.

methods.name: _check_equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another DTensorSpec, optionally skipping shape comparison.

methods.name: __eq__
methods.description: Equality comparison with another object.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the DTensorSpec.

methods.name: is_default_device_order
methods.description: Checks if the shard order is the default left-to-right device order.

methods.name: format_shard_order_str
methods.description: Formats the sharding pattern as a human-readable string.

methods.name: shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the tensor from tensor_meta.

methods.name: stride
methods.description: Returns the stride of the tensor from tensor_meta.

methods.name: ndim
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions of the tensor.

methods.name: num_shards
methods.description: Calculates total number of shards based on placements.

methods.name: device_mesh
methods.description: Returns the device mesh associated with the tensor.

methods.name: dim_map
methods.description: Returns a list mapping tensor dimensions to mesh dimensions, with -1 for replication.

methods.name: num_shards_map
methods.description: Returns a list of shard counts per tensor dimension.

methods.name: sums
methods.description: Returns list of mesh dims with pending partial sums.

methods.name: from_dim_map
methods.description: Creates a DTensorSpec from a device mesh, dim_map, sums, and optional tensor metadata.

methods.name: is_replicated
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is fully replicated across all mesh dims.

methods.name: is_sharded
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is sharded on any mesh dims.

methods.name: shallow_copy_with_tensor_meta
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the DTensorSpec with a new tensor_meta.
